name: Starship
description: Two-stage vehicle built around the methane-burning Raptor engine — Super Heavy first stage (33 Raptors) + Starship second stage (6 Raptors). Designed for full and rapid reuse via tower-catch recovery of both stages, targeting Mars transit timelines + Artemis Human Landing System. First integrated flight test (IFT-1) cleared the pad on 2023-04-20 but lost vehicle control before stage separation; successful payload deliveries began with IFT-4 in June 2024.
best_known_for: Fully reusable super-heavy launch vehicle in development for Artemis HLS + Mars
